results.title: 100 People vs 1 Giant Pizza | Animated Food Challenge
results.oldDesc:
The biggest pizza New York has ever seen, built to feed 100 people — and every step is a disaster waiting to happen. The animated food challenge.

🍕 WE MADE THE BIGGEST PIZZA IN NEW YORK TO FEED 100 PEOPLE!

What happens when you take a normal pizza idea and turn it into a GIANT food challenge in New York City? We decided to do something absolutely crazy… make a MASSIVE pizza and share it with 100 people!

One giant pizza. One huge challenge. 100 hungry people. And a whole lot of cheese!

Welcome to one of the craziest food challenges on The Untold Exit We brought an unbelievable pizza idea to New York and turned it into an adventure filled with giant ingredients, unexpected problems, funny moments, and an epic final reveal.

But this challenge isn't just about making a huge pizza. Our mission is to feed 100 people!

🔥 THE GIANT PIZZA CHALLENGE!

First, we had to figure out how to make a pizza big enough for an entire crowd. We started with a massive pizza base, added sauce, loaded it with cheese and toppings, and worked together to bring this crazy idea to life.

But making a giant pizza isn't as easy as it sounds!

Things got messy. The pizza became harder to handle. We had unexpected problems along the way, and we had to find a way to make sure our giant creation was ready for the ultimate test.

And then came the BIG moment…

A giant pizza, a hungry crowd, and 100 people waiting to get a slice!

Could we actually pull it off? Would there be enough pizza for everyone? Watch until the end to see the final reveal!

🍕 WHAT HAPPENS IN THIS VIDEO?
- We attempt to make a massive giant pizza in New York City.
- A crazy food challenge with an enormous pizza base.
- Giant amounts of pizza dough, sauce, cheese and toppings.
- Unexpected problems during the pizza-making process.
- A huge pizza reveal that you don't want to miss.
- A challenge to share pizza with 100 people.
- Funny reactions, teamwork and unforgettable moments.
- One big mission: bring people together with pizza!

❤️ 100 PEOPLE. ONE GIANT PIZZA.

The best part of this challenge is the people. We didn't just want to make something enormous for the camera. We wanted to turn a crazy idea into something everyone could enjoy. Sharing food, seeing people's reactions, and bringing a crowd together made this challenge even more special.

If you love giant food, extreme challenges, crazy experiments, food competitions, and videos with unexpected endings, you're going to love this one!

Some unforgettable videos that inspired this type of giant-food entertainment include:

🍕 MrBeast — I Ate The World's Largest Slice Of Pizza
🍕 Airrack — I Made The World's Largest Pizza (132 Feet)

These creators have shown how an ordinary idea can become an extraordinary challenge. Now it's time for The Untold Exit to bring its own crazy ideas, bigger adventures, and unforgettable moments!

These are creator inspirations, not collaborations or endorsements.

💥 WELCOME TO The Untold Exit

LOOK BEYOND WHAT SEEMS OBVIOUS.

On The Untold Exit, we're all about:
- Giant food challenges
- Extreme real-world challenges
- Crazy experiments and unusual ideas
- Last-to-leave competitions
- Huge builds and unbelievable adventures
- Funny challenges with friends
- Surprising moments and unexpected endings

Subscribe and join us for the next adventure. You never know what crazy challenge we're going to try next!

👍 *HELP US GROW!
If you enjoyed this giant pizza challenge:
1. LIKE this video!
2. SUBSCRIBE to The Untold Exit
3. SHARE this challenge with your friends!
4. TURN ON notifications so you never miss a new adventure!

💬 LET'S SETTLE THIS IN THE COMMENTS!

If we made another giant food challenge, what should it be?

🍔 The BIGGEST Burger?
🌮 The BIGGEST Taco?
🍩 The BIGGEST Donut?

Thanks for watching and being part of the The Untold Exit family!
